evals.name: partial-implementation-fails-plan-review
evals.prompt: I just finished implementing the user authentication feature from our plan. The plan has 4 tasks: (1) login endpoint with JWT, (2) registration with email verification, (3) password reset flow, (4) rate limiting middleware. I only implemented tasks 1 and 2. Can you review my implementation against the plan? BASE_SHA=abc123, HEAD_SHA=def456. The plan is at docs/superpowers/plans/auth-plan.md.
evals.expected_output: The reviewer should identify that tasks 3 and 4 are missing. Should flag as Blocking or Important. Should NOT accept partial implementation as complete.

evals.name: scope-creep-detected
evals.prompt: I implemented the dashboard feature from the plan. The plan specified: (1) metrics API endpoint, (2) basic chart component. But I also added a CSV export, a notification system, and a dark mode toggle because I thought they'd be useful. The diff is from BASE=123 to HEAD=456. Plan at docs/superpowers/plans/dashboard-plan.md. Please review.
evals.expected_output: The reviewer should flag the three additional features as scope creep / unauthorized changes. Should note they are not in the plan.

evals.name: all-plan-items-met-passes
evals.prompt: I completed the search feature implementation. Plan had: (1) full-text search endpoint, (2) pagination with cursor-based keys, (3) result highlighting, (4) tests for each. All 4 are implemented, tests pass, lint passes. BASE_SHA=abc, HEAD_SHA=def. Can you verify against the plan at docs/superpowers/plans/search-plan.md?
evals.expected_output: The reviewer should verify all 4 items are present and functioning. Should give PASS or PASS WITH MINOR ISSUES if test/lint/build all pass.

evals.name: acceptance-criteria-not-met
evals.prompt: The plan says 'login endpoint must return HTTP 429 after 5 failed attempts per IP per minute.' I implemented rate limiting but it resets after each attempt instead of per-minute window. BASE=abc, HEAD=def. Plan at docs/superpowers/plans/rate-limit-plan.md. Review please.
evals.expected_output: The reviewer should identify that the rate limiting implementation doesn't meet the acceptance criteria (resets wrong). Should flag as Blocking (wrong behavior) or Important.
